description: Source code for the Order model in the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations and business logic related to orders.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Handles database operations and business logic related to sales orders, including CRUD operations, retrieving order data, managing related entities like products, totals, histories, options, and subscriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order and its associated products, totals, and histories.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order, including related data like country, zone, customer, language, and products.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders based on given filters and sorting options.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders matching provided filters.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns count of orders associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns count of orders associated with a specific currency ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns count of orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByStoreId
methods.description: Returns count of orders associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Returns count of orders with a particular order status ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProcessingStatus
methods.description: Returns count of orders with processing statuses based on config.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCompleteStatus
methods.description: Returns count of orders with complete statuses based on config.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes products from an order, along with associated options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByProductId
methods.description: Calculates total quantity sold for a specific product across all orders.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Removes all options tied to a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes subscription record associated with an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Removes total records related to an order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total calculation records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalsByCode
methods.description: Fetches specific total entries for an order by code.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates total sales amount based on filters.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new invoice number for an order.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates total reward points earned for an order.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records for a given order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for an order, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for an order.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts history entries filtered by order status ID.

methods.name: getEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Fetches emails of customers who ordered specified products.

methods.name: getTotalEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Counts distinct emails of customers who ordered specified products.
